Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m. AMENDED - ADDED ITEM 10C

6:00
p.m.

Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.

Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
2021-10-27 Item 05 Oral Communications Received up to 3PM 102721
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 13, 2021 Special Meeting/Closed Session, and the October 13, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-10-27 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Sanderson
Staff recommends that the City Council review and approve the warrants.
2021-10-27 Item 08B Approval of Warrants List
8C.
Adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2021-13 which proposes Municipal Code amendments to implement the measures in the City’s Climate Action Plan related to residential and commercial building energy efficiency, renewable energy, and building decarbonization. CASE NOS: PLCY-004592-2021; LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Sustainability Manager Najera
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2021-13, titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of Encinitas, Adopting Amendments to Chapter 23.12 (Uniform Codes for Construction) or Title 23 (Building and Construction) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to Adopt the 2019 California Building Code and California Green Building Code with Certain Amendments, Additions, and Deletions related to Energy Efficiency, Solar Energy and Building Decarbonization” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-10-27 Item 08C Green Building Ordinance Adoption
8D.
Off-cycle Fiscal Year 2021-22 budget appropriation for Solid Waste Fund 214 and Amendment 1 to the agreement for environmental education services between the City of Encinitas and Solana Center for Environmental Innovation. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-98 approving an off-cycle appropriation to the Fiscal Year 2021-22 operating budget for the Solid Waste Fund 214 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for updates to the Solid Waste Division Program, including Senate Bill (SB) 1383 implementation support; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment 1 to the one-year agreement with Solana Center for Environmental Innovation to provide environmental education services for an additional amount of $41,679, for a new agreement total not-to-exceed $138,920 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-10-27 Item 08D Solid Waste Program Contract Amendment
8E.
Acceptance of the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Improvements Phase 1 Project (CC04J). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
1) Authorize the filing of the Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the subject project; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion; and 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-101 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report), entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Accepting the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Improvements Phase 1 Project” accepting the public improvements for the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Improvements Phase 1 Project as complete to the satisfaction of the City.
2021-10-27 Item 08E Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Phase 1 NOC
8F.
Second Reading of the Ordinance for changing the name of the Traffic and Public Safety Commission to the Mobility and Traffic Safety Commission. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2021-20 entitled, “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Chapter 2.40 to the Encinitas Municipal Code” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) which makes minor administrative changes to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission (TPSC) including changing the name of the commission to the Mobility and Traffic Safety Commission.
2021-10-27 Item 08F Ordinance Adoption Traffic Commission Name Change
8G.
Additional funding to complete the design, permitting and entitlements required for the Birmingham Drive Complete Streets Project (CS17B). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-99 entitled, “A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 Budget” to transfer $187,000 to the Birmingham Drive Complete Streets Project from the General Mobility Improvements Project (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-10-27 Item 08G Birmingham Dr Complete Streets - Additional Funding
8H.
Electric Vehicle Charging Plaza Lease Agreement located at 561 S. Vulcan Avenue, between the City of Encinitas and EVgo LLC. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Authorize the City Manager to execute a Lease Agreement in substantial form (Attachment 1 of the agenda report), in consultation with the City Attorney, between EVgo Services LLC (EVgo) and the City of Encinitas (City) to construct and operate an Electric Vehicle Charging Plaza for an initial three-year term with options to extend for two additional three-year terms. The annual payment to the City is $20,913 for the first year with a 3 percent increase for each subsequent year for a three-year total payment amount of $64,640. The total payments for the possible nine-year term if all renewal options are exercised is $212,460.
2021-10-27 Item 08H EV Charging Plaza
2021-10-27 Item 08H EV Charging Plaza - Amended Agenda Report 102521

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
